thread:
Tara: Posting condensed postmortem follow-up for Cust-Orchid Dedicated. Root cause: transient peering route instability during control-plane roll + on-prem NAT conntrack exhaustion. Result: subset of worker nodes lost connectivity intermittently. Summary + actions below.

Kev: Owners and short ETAs please. Also, is this an isolated customer problem or part of a pattern?

Sofia: Pattern: repeating. We've flagged the same interaction (peering churn + conntrack limits) across multiple Dedicated customers over past 9 months, usually during heavy deploy windows. Worth a cross-cutting remediation.

Ben: Lab repro notes: replayed 400 short-lived TCP connections while inducing a route withdraw. Observed conntrack table saturation and dropped SYNs. Kernel sample: `nf_conntrack: table full, dropping packet`. Repro snippet for runbook: ```for i in {1..400}; do timeout 1 bash -c "</dev/tcp/${PEER_IP}/$((1024 + i % 3000))" & done; sleep 2; dmesg | tail -n 40 | grep conntrack```

Tara: Proposed owners:
- Kev: peering routing & fallback policy + telemetry (owner) 
- Ben: on-prem reproducibility, NAT sizing guidance, runbook edits (owner)
- Sofia: CS comms & SLA assessment (owner)
- Tara: program lead + exec update (owner)

Kev: Short-term mitigations to push today: enable tenant-level fallback to regional replica (ETA 3h), apply gateway keepalive tune (tcp_keepalive_time=15s) (ETA 1h), add conntrack>75% alert to Ops (ETA 6h).

Ben: Mid/long actions: publish "NAT pool sizing" doc with sample formulas and checklist for Dedicated cutovers (ETA 7d), add conntrack headroom alert + automated remediation play (scale NAT pool or trigger fallback) (ETA 10d), share lab logs in REM ticket.

Sofia: Customer comms draft: "We've applied temporary routing failovers to maintain availability and are working on permanent mitigations. Expect a detailed timeline within 7 business days." I'll send initial note within 45m.

AlertBot: Created tickets INC-61234, REM-61235, CS-61236. Links: https://jira.redwood/INC-61234

Kev: Cross-customer task: correlate peering BGP flap events with control-plane deploy windows for the last 180 days and surface high-risk deploy slots. Owner: Kev; ETA 2025-09-15. Also proposing monthly "peering retrospective" in incident rotation.

Tara: Good. Please attach runbook snippet, kernel logs, and sizing calc to REM-61235. We'll reconvene in the peering retrospective next week to finalize program-level mitigations. If anything blocks, escalate on #eng-oncall. Closing this thread after Jira links & artifacts are attached. :thumbsup:
